svg.title: The recommended 01005 footprint
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. The recommended 01005 (0402 metric) footprint: two pads 0.25 mm long and 0.23 mm wide on a 0.41 mm pitch, leaving a 0.16 mm gap. The 0.4 × 0.2 mm part sits with both metal ends on the pads. Solder mask expansion 0.025 mm maximum.

g.text: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Footprint from the table in PCB-DFA-029.
